title: 同じプロンプトを流用してMiniMax H3（ローカル）でも30秒広告動画を作る（前半15秒をImage to Video、後半15秒をReference…
content:
同じプロンプトを流用してMiniMax H3（ローカル）でも30秒広告動画を作る（前半15秒をImage to Video、後半15秒をReference to Videoで分ける）  
Reference to Videoでは参照画像を3枚入れて15秒生成する  
RTX 4070 Ti SUPER 16GB / RAM 64GB環境で、Turboなし＋軽量化ありの場合の目安としてImage to Video 15秒は約11分、Reference to Video（参照画像3枚）15秒は約30分かかる

en.content:
Reuse the same prompt to create a 30-second ad video in MiniMax H3 (local), splitting it into two parts: the first 15 seconds as Image to Video and the second 15 seconds as Reference to Video.  
In Reference to Video, generate 15 seconds using three reference images.  
As a rough estimate in an RTX 4070 Ti SUPER 16GB / RAM 64GB environment, with Turbo off and lightweight optimization enabled, Image to Video for 15 seconds takes about 11 minutes, while Reference to Video (3 reference images) for 15 seconds takes about 30 minutes.
